purpose: Owner-approved, per-URL migration decisions. Only entries with status 'approved' are applied by the resolver, and every decision type can only DOWNGRADE what a legacy URL was served with. Proposals live in main/data/recovery/seo_url_disposition.jsonl and are never applied from there.

decision_types.noindex: robots -> noindex, follow; removed from sitemaps
decision_types.canonical_to: rel=canonical -> target (the target must resolve to an indexable self-canonical page; otherwise ignored)
decision_types.redirect_to: the page is replaced by a redirect to target (GitHub Pages cannot send HTTP 301; see url_decision_rules.json)
decision_types.retire: the page is removed (served 404 by GitHub Pages)
